metadata.title: DSCF-Net public final reproducibility package
metadata.description: Paper-final reproducibility materials for DSCF-Net, including source code, dataset split records, environment files, result JSON/CSV files, confusion-matrix outputs, and scripts for reproducing the reported tables and figures. Original UCM, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45 images are not redistributed and should be obtained from their original providers. The optional checkpoint archive contains six main-experiment checkpoints for evaluating the final DSCF-Net and regenerating the confusion matrices reported in the paper.
